name: Tanda

queries.query: Tanda Uttar Pradesh official cadastral map parcel GIS land records Ambedkar Nagar Bhu Naksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha, the Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh land-record portal, the official Ambedkar Nagar district land-record service page, and the Government of Uttar Pradesh cadastral digitization dashboard. The current BhuNaksha viewer was then inspected anonymously.

queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery identified the official Ambedkar Nagar district भूलेख-खतौनी page, the Uttar Pradesh भूलेख portal, and the official BhuNaksha viewer. The viewer's native hierarchy lists district अम्बेडकरनगर, tehsil टाण्डा, and village टांडा खास.

officialSources.observation: Official Government of Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha viewer. Current HTML and JavaScript identify the public service base https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver and REST routes for level selection, map extent and plot lookup. The inspected hierarchy returned district code 178 अम्बेडकरनगर, tehsil code 00907 टाण्डा, and village code 217117 टांडा खास with hasData=false.

Official Ambedkar Nagar district service page routes residents to the Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh land-record service. This is local district service-custodian evidence, not proof of an open parcel feature API.

Official Uttar Pradesh cadastral-map digitization dashboard reports Ambedkarnagar coverage totals and linked/geo-referenced map counts at district level; it does not provide a city-bounded parcel geometry response.

requests.outcome: Fetched current public viewer HTML. It exposed the current JavaScript bundle and same-host BhuNaksha server base; no login or credentials were used.
Returned Uttar Pradesh district selection data, including native district code 178 and name अम्बेडकरनगर.
Returned tehsil selection data, including native code 00907 and name टाण्डा.

Returned 421 village entries for Tanda tehsil. Native entry code 217117, name टांडा खास, had extraParams.hasData=false. The unchanged bounded response is in ignored scratch evidence under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/tanda/level3.json.
Returned native hierarchy-derived GIS code 17800907217117. This is a source hierarchy key, not a parcel identity.
Returned xmin=0, ymin=0, xmax=0, ymax=0, attribution=null and GIS code 0917800907; no usable map extent or CRS was returned. This is an access/data limitation, not evidence of citywide absence.
Returned an empty JSON object. No parcel identity, schema or geometry was obtained.
Returned an empty JSON object. The exact WUP point was used as supplied only as a bounded probe; no hit/miss conclusion was drawn and the coordinate was not shifted.

Both alternate hierarchy/GIS-code extent probes produced server-side 500 errors citing an upstream 403 createGisCode request. No retry escalation, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token or TLS exception was used.

registryBasis: The official Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha viewer exposes the Ambedkar Nagar/Tanda hierarchy and native village selection, while the official Ambedkar Nagar district page routes to the state land-record service. This establishes an evidenced local/state cadastral service route, but not a usable city-bounded open parcel geometry response.
